papers.title: VL-DPO: Vision-Language-Guided Finetuning for Preference-Aligned Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zhefan Xu, Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University (Zhefan Xu), Waymo (Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat)
papers.intro: 本文提出VL-DPO，利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为零样本推理器，自动生成轨迹偏好对，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）微调运动预测模型，实现与人类驾驶偏好的有效对齐。

papers.title: Probability-Conserving Flow Guidance
papers.authors: Parsa Esmati, Junha Hyung, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Jaegul Choo, Majid Mirmehdi
papers.affiliations: University of Bristol (Parsa Esmati, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Majid Mirmehdi), KAIST (Junha Hyung, Jaegul Choo)
papers.intro: 本文从概率守恒的连续性方程出发，将引导项分解为散度项和分数平行项，提出自适应流形引导（AdaMaG）的即插即用采样规则，通过对两者进行约束（分数平行阻尼+晚期时间衰减）来保持轨迹在流形上，从而在无额外推理成本下改善生成质量。

papers.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
papers.authors: Gueter Josmy Faure, Min-Hung Chen, Jia-Fong Yeh, Hung-Ting Su, Winston H. Hsu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual question answering, video search
papers.affiliations: National Taiwan University, Google, Independent Researcher
papers.intro: 本文提出了FineBench——一个包含199,420个QA对、基于64个长视频的密集标注人类中心视频问答基准，并提出了FineAgent模块化框架，通过Localizer和Descriptor组件显著提升开放源码VLMs在细粒度人类活动理解上的表现。

papers.title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Jinbiao Wei, Qianran Ma, Yilun Zhao, Xiao Zhou, Kangqi Ni, Guo Gan, Arman Cohan
papers.affiliations: Yale NLP Lab (Yale University), University of Pennsylvania, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
papers.intro: OpenComputer提出了一种以可验证性为核心（verifier-grounded）的框架，能够自动合成包含可执行环境、任务描述和可编程验证器的桌面软件世界，用于规模化构建和评估计算机使用智能体，并通过自进化验证层提高了评估可靠性。

papers.title: Dual-Prompt CLIP with Hybrid Visual Encoders for Occluded Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Zhangjian Ji, Shaotong Qiao, Kai Feng, Wei Wei
papers.affiliations: School of Computer & Information Technology, Shanxi University; Key Laboratory of Computational Intelligence and Chinese Information Processing of Ministry of Education
papers.intro: 本文提出DPL-ReID模型，通过双提示学习（Dual-PL）同时建模完整行人语义和遮挡感知语义，结合真实世界遮挡增强（RWOA）与加权门控特征融合（WGFF），在多个遮挡ReID基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Knowing When Not to Predict: Self Supervised Learning and Abstention for Safer DR Screening
papers.authors: Muskaan Chopra, Lorenz Sparrenberg, Jan H. Terheyden, Rafet Sifa
papers.affiliations: Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn, Bonn, Germany（作者1,4）；University Hospital Bonn - Department of Ophthalmology, Germany（作者3）；Fraunhofer IAIS, Sankt Augustin, Germany（作者4部分）；Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, Germany（作者4部分）
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了自监督预训练时长如何影响糖尿病视网膜病变筛查中的校准置信度和基于置信度的弃权行为，发现长预训练不单调提升可靠性，选择性性能在准确率饱和后仍会显著变化，强调需将预训练时长作为可靠性相关设计选择来对待。

papers.title: EgoBabyVLM: Benchmarking Cross-Modal Learning from Naturalistic Egocentric Video Data
papers.authors: Dongyan Lin, Phillip Rust, Angel Villar Corrales, Alvin W. M. Tan, Mahi Luthra, Charles-Éric Saint-James, Rashel Moritz, Sheila Krogh-Jespersen, Vanessa Stark, Surya Parimi, Jiayi Shen, Youssef Benchekroun, Yosuke Higuchi, Martin Gleize, Tom Fizycki, Nicolas Hamilakis, Manel Khentout, Sho Tsuji, Balázs Kégl, Juan Pino, Michael C. Frank, Emmanuel Dupoux
papers.affiliations: Meta Superintelligence Labs, Stanford University, Meta Reality Labs, École Normale Supérieure, The University of Tokyo
papers.intro: 本文提出EgoBabyVLM挑战，包括最大规模的自然主义婴儿第一人称视频数据集BabyView（863小时）和自动生成的语料库基语言接地基准Machine-DevBench，实验证明无论是对比式（CLIP+）还是生成式（LLaVA）VLM在自然主义弱对齐数据上均接近随机水平，而精心对齐的数据上则接近…

papers.title: Generation of Heterogeneous PET Images from Uniform Organ Activity Maps Using a Pretrained Domain-Adapted Diffusion Model
papers.authors: Suya Li, Kaushik Dutta, Debojyoti Pal, Jingqin Luo, Kooresh I. Shoghi
papers.affiliations: Washington University School of Medicine; McKelvey School of Engineering, Washington University in St Louis; Washington University School of Medicine; Washington University in St Louis
papers.intro: 本文提出一种预训练域自适应扩散模型（PAD），通过两阶段粗到细训练策略和自然图像预训练文本到图像解码器，实现从均匀器官活动图生成视觉逼真且定量准确的异质性PET图像。

papers.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models
papers.authors: Youngsun Lim, Cusuh Ham, Pin-Yu Chen, Deepti Ghadiyaram
papers.tags: text-to-image, image generation, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: Boston University, Adobe, IBM Research, Boston University
papers.intro: 提出FAGER，一个基于智能体的框架，通过结合LLM的事实提议和参考引导的视觉事实提取与验证，构建结构化事实量规并转换为QA对进行VLM评估，同时提供无训练的事实性改进反馈。

papers.title: LiFT: Lifted Inter-slice Feature Trajectories for 3D Image Generation from 2D Generators
papers.authors: Xinhe Zhang, Yuyang Zhang, Pengfei Jin, Arnau Marin-Llobet, Na Li, Quanzheng Li
papers.tags: image generation, image-to-image, Image Feature Extraction
papers.affiliations: 未明确（但具体作者机构见第十二节）
papers.intro: LiFT提出一种将3D体积合成分解为逐切片2D生成和切片间特征轨迹学习的框架，通过轻量级深度索引轨迹模块使二维生成器获得三维一致性，在无监督和配对翻译设置中均实现高效高分辨率三维医学图像合成。

papers.title: MedFM-Robust: Benchmarking Robustness of Medical Foundation Models
papers.authors: Xiangxiang Cui, Tianjin Huang, Yifang Wang, Lijie Hu, Lu Yin
papers.affiliations: 北京师范大学、埃克塞特大学、伦敦大学学院、穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学、萨里大学
papers.intro: 本文提出MedFM-Robust基准，在8种影像模态上应用40种扰动（12种通用+28种医学特定），对5种视觉语言模型（VQA、视觉定位、描述）和2种分割模型（5种微调策略）进行全面鲁棒性评估，发现微调策略是决定鲁棒性的关键因素，其中全微调最鲁棒，LoRA退化最严重，医学特定扰动对分割损害尤为显著。

papers.title: Artifact-Bench: Evaluating MLLMs on Detecting and Assessing the Artifacts of AI-Generated Videos
papers.authors: Yuqi Tang, Yang Shi, Zhuoran Zhang, Qixun Wang, Xuehai Bai, Yue Ding, Ruizhe Chen, Bohan Zeng, Xinlong Chen, Xuanyu Zhu, Bozhou Li, Yuran Wang, Yifan Dai, Chengzhuo Tong, Xinyu Liu, Yiyan Ji, Yujie Wei, Yuhao Dong, Shilin Yan, Fengxiang Wang, Yi-Fan Zhang, Haotian Wang, Yuanxing Zhang, Pengfei Wan
papers.affiliations: HKUST(GZ), PKU, Kling Team, HDU, CASIA, ZJU, SJTU, HKUST, NJU, FDU, NTU, Shanghai AI Lab, THU
papers.intro: 本文提出了Artifact-Bench，一个基于三层级伪影分类体系的多任务基准，系统评估MLLMs在AI生成视频的伪影检测、真实感比较和细粒度诊断上的能力，并揭示了当前模型在伪影感知与推理上的根本局限。

papers.title: Harnessing Self-Supervised Features for Art Classification
papers.authors: Federico Melis, Davide Bilardello, Emanuele Prato, Evelyn Turri, Lorenzo Baraldi
papers.tags: image classification, Image Feature Extraction, text-to-image
papers.affiliations: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy
papers.intro: 论文系统比较了监督与自监督（DINO、CLIP）视觉骨干在艺术品风格和流派分类中的表现，证明使用自监督特征提取器（尤其是CLIP线性分类）能持续优于传统监督微调方法。

papers.title: Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent
papers.authors: Yongsheng Yu, Ziyun Zeng, Zhiyuan Xiao, Zhenghong Zhou, Hang Hua, Wei Xiong, Jiebo Luo
papers.affiliations: Yongsheng Yu - UofR, Ziyun Zeng - UofR, Zhiyuan Xiao - UofR, Zhenghong Zhou - UofR, Hang Hua - MIT-IBM, Wei Xiong - NVIDIA, Jiebo Luo - UofR
papers.intro: Aurora 提出一个将工具增强的视觉语言模型代理与统一视频扩散 Transformer 配对的框架，通过代理将不完整的原始用户请求自动转换为结构化的编辑计划，从而解决条件缺失问题，提升视频编辑的鲁棒性和自动化程度。

papers.title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation
papers.authors: Yukang Chen, Luozhou Wang, Wei Huang, Shuai Yang, Bohan Zhang, Yicheng Xiao, Ruihang Chu, Weian Mao, Qixin Hu, Shaoteng Liu, Yuyang Zhao, Huizi Mao, Ying-Cong Chen, Enze Xie, Xiaojuan Qi, Song Han
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA
papers.intro: LongLive-2.0提出基于NVFP4的全流程并行基础设施，通过平衡序列并行训练、NVFP4量化和推理优化，实现了长视频生成的高效训练与推理，并显著简化了训练管线，成为首个端到端NVFP4长视频生成系统。

papers.title: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
papers.authors: Ziyun Zeng, Hang Hua, Bocheng Zou, Mu Cai, Rogerio Feris, Jiebo Luo
papers.affiliations: University of Rochester, MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, University of Wisconsin-Madison
papers.intro: MementoGUI 是一个插件式多模态记忆控制框架，通过可学习的记忆控制器 MementoCore 对长期GUI交互历史进行在线选择、压缩和检索，显著提升冻结GUI骨干代理在长周期任务中的决策性能。

papers.title: View-Aware Semantic Alignment for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Quan Zhang, Zeqiang Cai, Peiming Zhao, Jingze Wu, Cailun Wu, Hongbo Chen, Jianhuang Lai
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University, China; Pazhou Lab (HuangPu), Guangdong, China; Guangdong Province Key Laboratory of Information Security Technology, Guangzhou, China; Key Laboratory of Machine Intelligence and Advanced Computing, Ministry of Education, China
papers.intro: 本文提出ViSA（View-aware Semantic Alignment），通过“视角感知语义对齐”框架，将视角不变身份线索与视角特有判别线索显式解耦并联合利用，从而显著提升航拍-地面行人再识别的跨视角匹配性能。

papers.title: Text-Video Retrieval With Global-Local Contrastive Consistency Learning
papers.authors: Xiaolun Jing, Xinxing Yang, Genke Yang
papers.affiliations: Ningbo Artificial Intelligence Institute, Department of Automation, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文提出一个简单高效的全局-局部对比一致性学习框架（GLCCL），通过无参数的全局-局部交互模块（GLIM）生成文本引导的多粒度视觉特征，并引入对比分数一致性损失（CSC）强化正负样本的判别力，在不引入额外参数的情况下显著提升文本-视频检索性能。

papers.title: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Yichao Liu, Huawen Shen, Liu Yu, Shiyu Liu, Zeyu Chen, Yu Zhou
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, multimodal learning, gui
papers.affiliations: Nankai University, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 提出DRS-GUI，一个无需额外训练的GUI grounding框架，通过模仿人类动态调整感知范围的策略，结合三种类人感知动作和蒙特卡洛树搜索规划，在搜索-预测范式下有效提升定位精度。

papers.title: Minerva-Ego: Spatiotemporal Hints for Egocentric Video Understanding
papers.authors: Arsha Nagrani, Jasper Uijilings, Shyamal Buch, Tobias Weyand, Sudheendra Vijayanarasimhan, Bo Hu, Ramin Mehran, David A Ross, Cordelia Schmid
papers.tags: video segmentation, tracking, video generation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Google DeepMind
papers.intro: 本文提出Minerva-Ego，一个基于HD-EPIC的长时程egocentric视频推理基准，为每个问题提供密集的时空推理轨迹注释，并通过实验证明利用"何时何地看"的时空提示可显著提升前沿模型的推理准确率。
